newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Apator IPO 1.8 times oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Polish Apator IPO 1.8 times oversubscribed.

text.p: The initial public offering of 1,400,015 shares of Polish gauge maker Apator SA at 20 zlotys per share was 1.8 times oversubscribed, the issue's manager Creditanstalt Securities said in a Friday statement.

In a separate statement Apator said the 23 investors who took part in book building for 800,000 new shares had their bids reduced by 48.74 percent, while the other 1,234 investors who sought shares had bids reduced by 77.83 percent.

It said that the seven investors who took part in book building for 600,015 existing shares the received the number of shares for which they bid, while the remaining 657 investors had their bids reduced by 48.73 percent.
"Demand came from investment funds based in Great Britain and from institutional and retail investors in Poland," Creditanstalt said.
Apator, which made a 4.8 million zloty net profit last year on sales of 74.2 million zlotys, plans to start trade on the Warsaw bourse's main market in March.
